instruction: A miniature lighthouse in glazed white porcelain with hand-painted cobalt-blue spiral stripes and a tiny domed lantern room. The glossy ceramic glaze pools slightly at the base ring, and a delicate gilded weathervane tops the crown like fine china.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Porcelain Lighthouse in a ceramic/porcelain style. A miniature lighthouse in glazed white porcelain with hand-painted cobalt-blue spiral stripes and a tiny domed lantern room. The glossy ceramic glaze pools slightly at the base ring, and a delicate gilded weathervane tops the crown like fine china. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
